entities.summary: Zeboim is the name in English of two or three places in the Hebrew Bible:Zeboim, Zeboiim or Tzvoyim was one of the "five cities of the plain" of Sodom, generally coupled with Admah. The territory of the Canaanites after the time of Noah was said to extend "from Sidon in the direction of Gerar as far as Gaza, and in the direction of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, as far as Lasha. Zeboim is also mentioned in Genesis 14:2, Deuteronomy 29:23, and Hosea 11:8. It had a king of its own, and was therefore a place of some importance.
